```{r template-setup}
#| include: false
d    <- load_processed()
spec <- load_spec()
d$age_group <- age_group(d$age)
cs_wave <- min(waves_present(d, primary[1]))   # cross-sectional wave = first wave measured
all_scores <- c("rwa", "anomie", "rel_deprivation", "rehabilitation",
                "attr_societal", "attr_individual")
nice <- c(rwa = "RWA", anomie = "Anomie", rel_deprivation = "Relative deprivation",
          rehabilitation = "Support for rehabilitation",
          attr_societal = "Societal attribution", attr_individual = "Individual attribution")
```

## Study and sample

Study E is a five-wave online panel of `r length(unique(d$exercise_id))` pseudonymous respondents in Germany. All respondents in this extract took part in all five waves, so the sample is **a selected group of panel stayers**, not a probability sample of the population. Results are unweighted and describe this sample only.

## Measure

```{r measure-table}
kable_out(item_table(spec, construct))
```

**Scoring.** Each score is the mean of its recoded items (range `r lo`–`r hi`, higher = more of the construct). A score is computed only when at least two thirds of its items were answered. Special codes (for example 97 "not able to answer", 99 "not specified") were set to missing before scoring.

## Data quality

**Analytic N** (respondents with a valid score):

```{r n-table}
kable_out(n_table(d, names(scores)))
```

**Item-level missingness and special codes:**

```{r item-quality}
kable_out(item_quality(d, unique(unlist(scores)), lo, hi))
```

## Distributions

```{r dist, results='asis', fig.height=2.6, fig.width=9}
for (s in primary) {
  cat("\n\n###", nice[s], "\n\n")
  print(dist_plot(d, s, nice[s], lo, hi))
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(kable_out(describe_by_wave(d, s)), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Psychometric evidence

```{r reliability}
rel <- reliability_table(d, scores)
if (!is.null(rel)) kable_out(rel) else cat("Single-item measure: internal consistency cannot be estimated (see validity evidence below).")
```

## Sociodemographic patterns (wave `r cs_wave`)

Groups with fewer than `r MIN_CELL` respondents are suppressed.

```{r groups, results='asis'}
for (s in primary) {
  cat("\n\n###", nice[s], "\n\n")
  for (v in c("gender", "age_group", "education", "east_west")) {
    cat("\n**By", v, "**\n\n")
    cat(kable_out(group_means(d, s, v, cs_wave)), sep = "\n")
  }
}
```

## Political and psychological correlates (wave `r cs_wave`)

```{r correlates, results='asis'}
others <- list(
  `Left-right self-placement (general)` = function(x) num_from_label(x$ideology),
  `Left-right (social issues)`          = function(x) num_from_label(x$ideology_soc),
  `Left-right (economic issues)`        = function(x) num_from_label(x$ideology_econ),
  `Household income (1-13)`             = function(x) income_num(x$income),
  `Age`                                 = function(x) x$age)
for (o in setdiff(all_scores, primary)) {
  local({ oo <- o; others[[nice[oo]]] <<- function(x) x[[oo]] })
}
for (s in primary) {
  cat("\n\n###", nice[s], "\n\n")
  tab <- correlates_table(d, s, others, cs_wave)
  if (is.null(tab)) cat("No correlates available in this wave.\n") else cat(kable_out(tab), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Adjusted analysis (wave `r cs_wave`)

Linear regression of the score on age (per 10 years), gender, education, household income and left-right self-placement. Categories with fewer than `r MIN_CELL` respondents are left out of the model. Coefficients are unstandardised (scale points).

```{r adjusted, results='asis'}
for (s in primary) {
  am <- tryCatch(adjusted_model(d, s, cs_wave), error = function(e) NULL)
  cat("\n\n###", nice[s], "\n\n")
  if (is.null(am)) { cat("Model could not be estimated.\n"); next }
  cat("n =", am$n, "; R² =", am$r2, "; adjusted R² =", am$adj_r2, "\n\n")
  cat(kable_out(am$table), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Longitudinal evidence

```{r longitudinal, results='asis', fig.height=3.2, fig.width=7}
for (s in primary) {
  cat("\n\n###", nice[s], "\n\n")
  if (length(waves_present(d, s)) < 2) { cat("Measured in one wave only.\n"); next }

  cat("\n**Mean level by wave** (all respondents vs. respondents never flagged by an attention check in any wave)\n\n")
  ok_all  <- mean_ci_by_wave(d, s)
  flagged <- wide_scores(transform(d, tmp = att_flag_any), "tmp") > 0
  keep    <- rowSums(flagged, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
  ok_attn <- mean_ci_by_wave(d, s, keep = keep)
  print(mean_plot(list(`All respondents` = ok_all, `Never flagged` = ok_attn), nice[s]))
  cat("\n\n")

  cat("\n**Paired change** (same respondents; d_z = mean change / SD of change)\n\n")
  cat(kable_out(change_table(d, s)), sep = "\n")

  cat("\n\n**Rank-order stability** (correlations between waves)\n\n")
  cat(kable_out(stability_matrix(d, s)), sep = "\n")

  cat("\n\n**Robustness: balanced panel vs. available cases**\n\n")
  cat(kable_out(balanced_vs_available(d, s)), sep = "\n")

  im <- tryCatch(icc_model(d, s), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(im)) {
    cat("\n\n**Random-intercept model** (share of variance between persons, and average change per wave)\n\n")
    cat(kable_out(im), sep = "\n")
  }
}
```
